User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the application.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the User entity, matching the Firebase Auth UID. Used as the document ID.

branchIds.description: The IDs of the branches the user is assigned to.

role.description: The user's role in the system.

customRoleId.description: The ID of the custom role assigned to the user, if applicable.

customRoleName.description: The name of the custom role assigned to the user.

institutionId.description: The ID of the institution the user belongs to. Required for institution-admin and staff roles.

appraisalLimit.description: The maximum loan amount this user is permitted to appraise.

PendingUser.title: PendingUser
PendingUser.description: Represents a user who has signed up but is awaiting admin approval.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Institution entity.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the institution was created.

shortName.description: A shorter name or acronym for the institution.

registrationNumber.description: The official registration number of the institution.

type.description: The type of the financial institution.

isDepositTaking.description: Indicates whether the institution is licensed to take deposits from members or the public.

location.description: The district or city where the institution is located.

physicalAddress.description: The physical street address of the institution's main office.

hqBranch.description: The details of the main branch, which defaults to 'Headquarters'.

id.description: Branch ID, defaults to '01' for HQ.

code.description: Branch code, defaults to '01' for HQ.

contactEmail.description: The primary contact email for the institution.

contactPhone.description: The primary contact phone number for the institution.

commissionTiers.description: Tiered commission rates for the institution.

customerCounter.description: A counter that increments for each new customer to generate unique account numbers.

loanCounter.description: A counter that increments for each new loan to generate unique loan IDs.

journalBatchCounter.description: A counter that increments for each new journal batch to generate unique batch IDs.

transactionReceiptCounter.description: A counter that increments for each new receipted transaction to generate unique transaction IDs.

systemDate.description: The current operational date for the institution, managed by the EOD process.

loanLossProvision.description: Rules for loan loss provisioning based on PAR buckets.

Employer.title: Employer
Employer.description: Represents an employer entity in the system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the employer.

name.description: The official name of the employer.

contactPerson.description: Name of the primary contact person.

Branch.title: Branch
Branch.description: Represents a single branch of a financial institution.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Branch, typically a 2-digit code.

code.description: A unique 2-digit code for the branch.

location.description: The physical location (district) of the branch.

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: Represents a monthly commission invoice for an institution.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Invoice.

institutionId.description: The ID of the institution this invoice belongs to.

amount.description: The total amount due on the invoice.

amountPaid.description: The total amount that has been paid towards the invoice.

status.description: The current status of the invoice.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the invoice was generated.

dueDate.description: The date by which the invoice should be paid.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Represents a payment made by an institution towards an invoice.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Payment.

invoiceId.description: The ID of the invoice this payment is for.

institutionId.description: The ID of the institution making the payment.

reference.description: A payment reference, such as a transaction ID.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the payment was recorded.

status.description: The status of the payment confirmation.

Loan.title: Loan
Loan.description: Represents a loan in the system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Loan.

institutionId.description: The ID of the institution that issued the loan.

branchId.description: The ID of the branch this loan belongs to.

customerId.description: The ID of the customer who took the loan.

loanProductId.description: The ID of the loan product this loan is based on.

amount.description: The principal amount of the loan.

outstandingPrincipal.description: The current remaining principal balance of the loan.

term.description: The duration of the loan term.

tenureUnit.description: The unit for the loan term (Days, Months, or Years).

dateApplied.description: The date the loan application was submitted.

disbursalDate.description: The date the loan was disbursed.

submittedBy.description: The ID of the staff member who submitted the application.

appraisedBy.description: The ID of the staff member who appraised the loan.

appraisalNotes.description: Notes from the loan officer during appraisal.

approvedBy.description: The ID of the staff member who approved the loan.

approvalDate.description: The date the loan was approved.

fees.description: A snapshot of the fees applied to this loan at the time of approval.

isRescheduled.description: Flag to indicate if this loan is a result of a reschedule.

isTopUp.description: Flag to indicate if this loan is a result of a top-up.

originalLoanId.description: If rescheduled or topped up, this holds the ID of the original loan.

rescheduledBy.description: The ID of the staff member who initiated the reschedule.

reversalReason.description: The reason for requesting a loan reversal.

reversalRequestedBy.description: The ID of the user who requested the reversal.

writeOffReason.description: The reason for requesting a loan write-off.

auditHistory.description: A log of all significant events and actions taken on the loan.

status.description: The current status of the loan.

ChartOfAccount.title: ChartOfAccount
ChartOfAccount.description: Represents a single account in the General Ledger.

id.description: Unique identifier for the account.

glCode.description: The General Ledger code for the account.

accountName.description: The name of the account (e.g., Cash on Hand).

subType.description: A more detailed classification (e.g., Current Asset).

isEditable.description: Whether the account details can be edited.

JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: Represents a double-entry financial transaction for a specific branch.

id.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry, also serving as the Batch ID.

branchId.description: The ID of the branch where this transaction occurred.

transactions.description: An array of debits and credits that make up the entry.

status.description: The status of the journal entry.

reversesJournalId.description: If this is a reversal entry, this holds the ID of the original entry.

SavingsProduct.title: SavingsProduct
SavingsProduct.description: Represents a configurable savings product offered by an institution.

id.description: Unique identifier for the savings product.

institutionId.description: The ID of the institution offering this product.

name.description: Public name of the savings product (e.g., 'Flexi Save Account').

code.description: Unique internal code for the product.

description.description: A short summary of the product's purpose and benefits.

status.description: The current status of the product.

startDate.description: Optional date when the product becomes available.

endDate.description: Optional date when the product is no longer available.

minDeposit.description: The minimum amount for subsequent deposits.

maxDeposit.description: The maximum amount for a single deposit transaction.

interestPosting.description: Frequency of posting interest to the account.

minWithdrawal.description: The minimum amount that can be withdrawn at a time.

maxWithdrawalsPerMonth.description: Limit on the number of withdrawals per month.

earlyWithdrawalPenalty.description: Penalty percentage for early withdrawals from fixed-term products.

dormancyPeriodMonths.description: Months of inactivity before an account is marked as dormant.

lockInPeriodMonths.description: Duration (in months) during which funds cannot be withdrawn.

maturityPeriodMonths.description: Total maturity period for fixed-term products.

autoRenew.description: Whether the product automatically renews upon maturity.

allowJointAccounts.description: If multiple individuals can jointly own an account.

allowLoanRecovery.description: Allows auto-debiting to cover overdue loan payments.

charges.description: List of IDs of applicable fees from the Fee Library.

savingsControlAccountId.description: ID of the GL liability account to link this product to.

ShareProduct.title: ShareProduct
ShareProduct.description: Represents a configurable share product offered by a SACCO or Cooperative.

id.description: Unique identifier for the share product.

name.description: Name of the share product (e.g., Ordinary Shares).

code.description: A short, unique code for the product.

description.description: A summary of the product's purpose and benefits.

minSharesPerMember.description: Minimum number of shares a member must hold.

maxSharesPerMember.description: Maximum number of shares a member can hold.

nominalValue.description: The face value of a single share.

sharesPayableAccountId.description: GL account for the total value of shares issued (Equity).

shareApplicationAccountId.description: Optional GL account to track funds for pending share applications.

sharePremiumAccountId.description: Optional GL account for amounts paid above nominal value.

transactionChargesIncomeAccountId.description: Optional GL account for income from share transaction fees.

allowPartialSharePurchase.description: Allow members to pay for a single share in installments.

allowMonthlyShareContributions.description: Allow regular monthly contributions towards shares.

allowLumpSumPurchases.description: Allow members to buy multiple shares at once.

allowAutomaticDeductions.description: Allow automatic share purchase deductions from savings.

minContributionAmount.description: Minimum amount for a single contribution.

eligibleForDividends.description: Determines if these shares qualify for dividend payouts.

dividendPayableAccountId.description: GL account for declared but unpaid dividends (Liability).

retainedEarningsAccountId.description: GL account from which dividends are paid (Equity).

allowShareWithdrawal.description: Determines if members can withdraw/sell their shares.

minHoldingPeriod.description: Minimum number of months a member must hold shares before withdrawal.

withdrawalNoticePeriod.description: Number of days notice required for a withdrawal.

withdrawalFee.description: A flat or percentage fee charged on share withdrawal.

partialWithdrawalAllowed.description: Allow members to withdraw a portion of their shares.

minMemberDuration.description: Minimum membership duration (months) before a member can buy shares.

maxSharePercentage.description: Maximum percentage of total institutional shares a single member can own.

linkedFees.description: List of IDs of applicable fees from the Fee Library.

SavingsAccount.title: SavingsAccount
SavingsAccount.description: Represents a specific savings account for a customer.

id.description: Unique identifier for the savings account.

branchId.description: The ID of the branch this savings account belongs to.

productId.description: The ID of the SavingsProduct this account is based on.

status.description: The current status of the savings account.

balance.description: The current balance of the account.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the account was opened.

LoanProduct.title: LoanProduct
LoanProduct.description: Represents a configurable loan product offered by an institution.

id.description: Unique identifier for the loan product.

institutionId.description: The ID of the institution offering this product.

name.description: Public name of the loan product (e.g., 'SME Growth Loan').

code.description: A short, unique code for the product (e.g., 'SME01').

description.description: A summary of the product's purpose and benefits.

loanType.description: The primary category of the loan.

linkedFees.description: List of IDs of applicable fees from the Fee Library.

linkedInventoryItems.description: List of IDs of inventory items linked to this loan product (e.g., for asset financing).

tenureUnit.description: The unit for the loan term (Days, Months, or Years).

gracePeriod.description: Number of days before the first repayment is due.

disbursementMethods.description: Allowed methods for disbursing the loan.

repaymentMethods.description: Allowed methods for repaying the loan.

loanPortfolioAccountId.description: ID of the GL Asset account to track outstanding principal.

interestIncomeAccountId.description: ID of the GL Income account to track interest earned.

minMemberDuration.description: Minimum number of months a person must be a member to qualify.

minSavingsBalance.description: Minimum savings balance required to qualify for the loan.

allowMultipleActiveLoans.description: Permit customers to have more than one of this loan at the same time.

allowLoanTopUp.description: Enable refinancing by adding funds to an active loan.

allowRescheduling.description: Permit modification of loan terms for customers in distress.

allowEarlyRepayment.description: Let customers pay off their loan ahead of schedule.

Fee.title: Fee
Fee.description: Represents a fee or charge that can be applied to a financial product.

id.description: Unique identifier for the fee.

institutionId.description: The ID of the institution this fee belongs to.

name.description: The descriptive name of the fee (e.g., 'Loan Processing Fee').

status.description: Whether the fee is currently in use.

trigger.description: The system event that automatically applies this fee.

calculationMethod.description: How the fee amount is calculated.

amount.description: The fixed amount for the fee, if calculationMethod is 'Flat Amount'.

percentage.description: The percentage for the fee, if calculationMethod is 'Percentage'.

percentageOf.description: The base value for percentage calculation.

collectionMethod.description: How the fee is collected from the customer.

incomeAccountId.description: The ID of the GL Income Account to post the revenue to.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: Represents a user role with a set of permissions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the role.

institutionId.description: The ID of the institution this role belongs to.

name.description: The name of the role (e.g., 'Loan Officer').

isSystemRole.description: Indicates if the role is a non-editable system role.

permissions.description: A list of permission keys assigned to this role.

Teller.title: Teller
Teller.description: Represents a teller configuration for an institution.

id.description: Unique identifier for the teller configuration.

institutionId.description: The ID of the institution this teller belongs to.

branchId.description: The ID of the branch this teller is assigned to.

userId.description: The ID of the staff member assigned as this teller.

role.description: The assigned role for the teller.

tillAccountId.description: The ID of the GL cash account linked to this teller's till.

maxCashLimit.description: Maximum cash amount the teller can hold.

status.description: The current status of the teller.

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Represents an individual or group customer of the institution.

id.description: Unique identifier for the customer.

branchId.description: The ID of the branch this customer belongs to.

accountNumber.description: The unique system-generated account number for the customer.

accountNumber_lowercase.description: Lowercase version of the account number for case-insensitive search.

name.description: The full name of the customer or group.

name_lowercase.description: The full name of the customer or group in lowercase.

kycStatus.description: The status of their KYC verification.

phone_lowercase.description: Lowercase version of the phone number for case-insensitive search.

photoUrl.description: URL to the customer's profile photo.

idNumber_lowercase.description: Lowercase version of the ID number for case-insensitive search.

isEmployee.description: Indicates if this customer is also an employee for payroll purposes.

salaryType.description: How the employee's salary is calculated.

salary.description: The gross monthly or periodic salary for the employee.

paymentMethod.description: How the employee receives their salary.

Payroll.title: Payroll
Payroll.description: Represents a payroll run for a specific employer for a given period.

id.description: Unique identifier for the payroll run.

employerId.description: The ID of the employer this payroll belongs to.

status.description: The current status of the payroll.

totalAmount.description: The total gross amount of the payroll run.

totalNet.description: The total net amount to be paid out.

processedBy.description: The ID of the user who processed the payroll.

processedAt.description: Timestamp when the payroll was processed.

Payslip.title: Payslip
Payslip.description: Represents an individual employee's payslip within a payroll run.

id.description: Unique identifier for the payslip.

payrollId.description: The ID of the payroll run this payslip belongs to.

customerId.description: The ID of the customer (employee) this payslip is for.

grossPay.description: The employee's gross pay for the period.

netPay.description: The final net pay after all deductions.

status.description: The payment status of the payslip.

UnfinalisedApplication.title: UnfinalisedApplication
UnfinalisedApplication.description: Represents a customer onboarding attempt that failed and requires manual review.

customerName.description: The name of the prospective customer.

reason.description: The reason why the onboarding failed (e.g., Duplicate ID).

idNumber.description: The ID number that caused the potential conflict.

payload.description: The full data payload of the attempted customer creation.

FinancialYear.title: FinancialYear
FinancialYear.description: Represents a financial/accounting year for an institution.

yearName.description: The name of the financial year (e.g., 'FY 2024-2025').

netProfitLoss.description: The calculated net profit or loss for the year upon closing.

WorkflowAudit.title: WorkflowAudit
WorkflowAudit.description: Logs changes to the maker-checker workflow controls.

userId.description: UID of the user who made the change.

component.description: The workflow component that was changed.

reason.description: The reason provided for the change.

InventoryItem.title: Inventory Item
InventoryItem.description: Represents a single item in the inventory.

InventoryCategory.title: Inventory Category
InventoryCategory.description: Represents a category for organizing inventory items.

UnitOfMeasure.title: Unit of Measure
UnitOfMeasure.description: Defines a unit for quantifying inventory items.

StaffAsset.title: Staff Asset
StaffAsset.description: Represents an inventory item issued to a staff member.

Supplier.title: Supplier
Supplier.description: Represents a supplier of goods and services.

id.description: Unique identifier for the supplier.

name.description: The official name of the supplier.

contactPerson.description: Name of the primary contact person.

Warehouse.title: Warehouse
Warehouse.description: Represents a physical location where inventory is stored.

location.description: The physical address or city of the warehouse.

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the main or primary warehouse.

InventoryLedger.title: Inventory Ledger
InventoryLedger.description: Records all movements of an inventory item.

PurchaseOrder.title: Purchase Order
PurchaseOrder.description: Represents an order to a supplier for goods or services.

GoodsReceiptNote.title: Goods Receipt Note
GoodsReceiptNote.description: A document confirming the receipt of goods from a supplier.

definition.description: Collection of user documents. Document ID is the user's UID.
